name: PoLARIS cloud polymer lab incl. Argonne Polybot (UChicago/Argonne, NSF 2026)
brief: A remotely accessible, robot-operated polymer and soft-materials laboratory: more than 20 autonomous stations (synthesis, formulation, characterisation including a synchrotron beamline) spread over five labs at two sites, coordinated by AI agents and a data layer, running 100 to 300 experiments a day for external users.

cost.excludes_note: A grant award, not a hardware cost. Source does not say what it covers; for a multi-year project it very likely includes staff, software, data infrastructure and integration as well as instruments. Do not compare against a hardware-only prediction. Existing instruments (Advanced Photon Source, existing labs) are reused, not purchased.

notes: Kept unverified as a cost case: a US$20M NSF grant of unstated coverage (likely staff and infrastructure). Useful for scale and throughput only. Verified 3 Oct 2026 from the UChicago news release (3 Aug 2026): "A $20 million grant will remove many of these barriers, developing a remotely accessible, robot-operated laboratory ..."; "PoLARIS will execute at more than 20 stations ... spread across five labs at UChicago and Argonne"; "Once fully operational, PoLARIS will be capable of running anywhere from 100 to 300 experiments a day." Weak like-for-like value: use as a scale sanity check and throughput check only. The throughput P50 of 200 is simply the midpoint of the reported 100-300 range.
